mathematical_reason: Stacks 12.3.1 requires abelian group structure on every hom-set and additivity in each argument of composition. These axioms alone do not guarantee existence of a zero object, finite direct sums, kernels or cokernels, so the independently screened formulation does not silently impose any of those stronger conditions.

Stacks 12.3.8 adds finite-product existence to preadditivity and explicitly gives zero object and direct sums as an equivalent characterization. The empty finite product is essential for the zero object. Merely bilinear composition is insufficient, and additivity does not imply all kernels or cokernels exist.

Stacks 12.5.1 imposes three independent requirements: additivity, existence of all kernels and cokernels, and invertibility of the canonical coimage-to-image comparison. The last condition cannot be dropped, since an additive category may have (co)kernels but fail that isomorphism. This definition is not interchangeable with preadditivity.
